dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: Oh, hello there! You must be the new neighbour. Welcome to the settlement!

dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: I won't lie to you, this place needs a bit of work. The electricity's been acting up something terrible.

dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: There's an electrical box in the living room. Go take a look and see if you can sort it out.

dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: Careful with the wires though! You don't want to be the reason the lights go out for the whole street!
